carbon.method: On-prem: measured hypervisor power (October average, until a continuous exporter is in place) × RTE éCO2mix intensity for the day. LCA: same energy × {factor} g/kWh ({source}). Cloud: estimate, coming soon.
carbon.trendHint: Energy as bars, daily average intensity as a line.
carbon.rteExplainer: Grid intensity is the amount of CO₂e emitted per kWh produced (gCO₂e/kWh), published by RTE éCO2mix every 15 minutes. It varies with the production mix: low at night and when it is windy, higher at evening peaks when gas is called on. It is used to compute measured emissions (energy × hourly intensity) and to pick low-carbon hours for batch jobs.

meta.title: CNP: Ship to hybrid cloud in a few clicks
meta.description: CNP is a self-service platform to deploy, secure and monitor your applications across OpenStack and AWS. No CLI, no Terraform, no IT ticket.

hero.badge: Self-service deployments on OpenStack + AWS, now from your AI assistant
hero.title: Ship your apps to the cloud in <accent>a few clicks</accent>, or one sentence to your AI assistant
hero.lead: {platform} lets your team deploy, secure and monitor full application stacks across a hybrid cloud. No CLI, no Terraform knowledge, no IT ticket. From Git repo to a running, monitored app in under two minutes.

stats.illustrative: Illustrative figures based on typical platform usage.

services.title: Everything you need to ship
services.intro: One platform that covers the whole journey, from your first deploy to running apps in production, with the cost and access controls to keep them healthy.

oneClick.title: One-click deployments
oneClick.desc: Push your project live in a single click. CNP provisions the infrastructure, wires the networking and rolls out your app. You just press Deploy.

templates.title: Ready-made templates
templates.desc: Start from a curated template (FastAPI · Python, static HTML/CSS) or bring your own. Import any existing Git repository and we take it from there.

secrets.title: Secret management
secrets.desc: Store API keys, tokens and credentials in a vault-backed store. Secrets are encrypted, scoped to your project and injected at runtime, never in your code.

rbac.title: RBAC team management
rbac.desc: Invite teammates and control exactly who can view, deploy or administer each project with fine-grained role-based access control.

visible.title: Apps visible in-platform
visible.desc: Every deployed app gets a live entry on CNP: open it, share it and reach your running service directly from the dashboard.

health.title: Real-time health
health.desc: Continuous health checks surface the live status of every application, so you catch issues the moment they appear instead of hours later.

finops.title: Built-in FinOps
finops.desc: Track the cost of each deployment in real time, spot the expensive ones and keep your cloud bill under control, no spreadsheets required.

identity.title: Identity-first accounts
identity.desc: Sign in through your Identity Provider (IDP). Single sign-on, centralised identity and zero extra passwords to manage.

benefits.title: Less plumbing. More shipping.
benefits.text: {platform} removes the friction between your code and the cloud, so your team spends its energy on the product, not on infrastructure.

steps.title: See every deployment step live
steps.desc: Watch each stage of your deployment unfold in real time, provisioning, build, rollout, with full transparency instead of a black box.

simple.title: As simple or as deep as you want
simple.desc: Sensible defaults get non-experts shipping in minutes, while every setting stays fully customisable for teams who want fine control.

visibility.title: Real-time visibility
visibility.desc: Live monitoring keeps you on top of your apps' health and behaviour at a glance, so you spend less time guessing and more time building.

catalogue.title: A catalogue that does the heavy lifting
catalogue.desc: A growing catalogue of services and templates removes boilerplate and makes development and deployment dramatically easier.

docs.title: Documentation, automatically
docs.desc: CNP generates documentation straight onto the repository of every deployed application. Your project stays documented without the busywork.

cta.title: Your next deployment is one click away
cta.text: Log in with your identity provider and deploy your first project on {platform} today.
